notes_for_editor: Thin record. Both sources are index listings giving a name, county and agency (GFC), and tnlandforms adds coordinates. No source read gives a build date, staffing, status, access or site description, so the story is short on purpose (about 40 words) rather than padded. Searches for a Mitchell County fire tower history returned nothing tower-specific. The brief's status and access stay unknown. The registration GFC US 210 appears only as the tnlandforms code gfc-210. A human could ask the Georgia Forestry Commission or Mitchell County for records.
